newsitem.title: FRANCE: CLF says IBCA confirmed AAA debt rating.
newsitem.headline: CLF says IBCA confirmed AAA debt rating.

text.p: French bank Credit Local de France said on Monday European credit rating agency IBCA had confirmed an AAA rating on its long-term debt.
Credit Local also said IBCA had maintained its financial strength rating at A.

Credit Local said IBCA had based its decision on the bank's ability to generate profits, the quality of its assets, the weight of its core shareholder funds and the potential synergies coming out of CLF's alliance with Credit Communal de Belgique.

An IBCA spokeswoman told Reuters the rating agency had affirmed the rating at the end of September but had not made the decision public. It had already affirmed the rating in March 28 this year, two weeks after CLF announced plans to form a closer alliance with Credit Communal de Belgique.
In October, Moody's Investor Services cut CLF's long-term debt rating to Aa1 from Aaa and lowered the bank's financial strength rating to B+ from A-.
